scope: Broadened ShipDeck lifecycle census and protocol-owned server coordinator design selection

selectedDesignOwner.name: GlobalMotionShipDeckPassengerLifecycleCoordinator
selectedDesignOwner.role: single protocol-owned server lifecycle coordinator and immutable ledger owner
selectedDesignOwner.reason: owns ship lifetime, passenger attachment, NGO authority and terminal invalidation order without selecting a passenger-local or spawn-only existing seam

rejectedExistingSeams.NpcBrain: passenger-local attach/detach; does not own ship registration/despawn or NGO ownership
rejectedExistingSeams.ShipCrewSpawner: crew spawn/cleanup seam; does not own attachment completion, ship invalidation or protocol order

receiptMapping.ShipRegistered: server-accepted ship registration opens a new explicit ship lifetime/spawn generation
receiptMapping.PassengerAttached: server-confirmed active attach plus parent completion and ShipDeckNav.IsReady opens a new attachment generation
receiptMapping.PassengerDetached: server-confirmed detach closes the matching active attachment generation
receiptMapping.ShipInvalidated: terminal server ship despawn/invalidation closes the ship lifetime, records last order/reason and forbids later passenger receipts

generationRequirements.shipLifetimeSpawnGeneration: server-issued, strictly monotonic per accepted ship lifetime, never reused after despawn/recreate
generationRequirements.passengerAttachmentGeneration: server-issued per ship/passenger attachment epoch, strictly increases for each new attach; detach closes the active value
generationRequirements.ledgerOrder: strictly monotonic coordinator order across all receipts

identityOwnershipOrderInvalidation.identity: explicit stable protocol ship/passenger identity; NetworkObjectId is supplemental transport identity only
identityOwnershipOrderInvalidation.ownership: server authority and protocol ownership required; client/local owner observations cannot issue receipts
identityOwnershipOrderInvalidation.order: ShipRegistered first; attach/detach pairs ordered; ShipInvalidated terminal
identityOwnershipOrderInvalidation.invalidation: stale, duplicate, mismatched or post-terminal receipts fail closed

futureBindingPath.sourceInput: reviewed receipts from the selected coordinator, not direct component callbacks or object scans
futureBindingPath.providerAdapterBinding: deferred until a later reviewed gate

nextGate: implement and owner-review the selected protocol-owned coordinator without synthetic generation shortcuts
